identity.description: Converts the interactive yield matrix dashboard into traceable research insights. Explains quarter-by-quarter yield rankings, prior/current aggregate comparisons, yield bands, and timeline metrics with exact source references. Ideal for generating research notes directly from dashboard exploration.

capabilities.dataCoverage: 8 quarters, 59 assets, 6 focus assets, 4 yield bands, investment score breakdown

inputs.description: Question about the matrix, quarter, asset, aggregate, legend, or timeline.

outputs.description: Plain-language insight with exact field and source references.

skill.userValue: Use the matrix to prioritize assets and questions for deeper risk, liquidity, methodology, and provenance review. Open the cited source rows and compare supplied target labels with independently observed data.
